title: I made an idle game where you prestige into Regret, then Indifference
author: Dignified_Cyclops
selftext:
I’ve been building **Dopamine Clicks**, a browser idle game about the deeply meaningful pursuit of a larger number.

You click for dopamine, hire Unpaid Interns, and invest in things like Premium Self-Worth and Institutional Inertia. Your first prestige is called **A Sense of Completion**. It resets your progress and gives you **Regret**.

Eventually, you can trade that for **Indifference**. The commentary becomes progressively less interested in your achievements.

There are upgrades, achievements, offline earnings, and increasingly elaborate automation. You can eventually delegate purchases, reward claims, and even prestiging. Your attendance becomes largely administrative.

It’s an early web prototype with a mobile-friendly layout. I’d love some feedback on the pacing, whether the prestige choices are clear, and when the automation starts feeling like actual paperwork.

**Play:** [**https://dopamineclicks.com/**](https://dopamineclicks.com/)

Fulfillment sold separately. There is currently no fulfillment shop.
